units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 14:23">Targ. Y. I Gen. XIV, 23</cite> <he>סַנְדְּלַת רצועא</he> a sandal provided with straps; Y. II <he>רצועה דס׳</he> a shoe-strap.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 108:10">Targ. Ps. CVIII, 10</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44">Gen. R. s. 44</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 285:4">Yalk. Jer. 285</cite> <he>עד דסַנְדְּלָךְ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K00180"><he>כּוּבָּא</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7b:13">Snh. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>אפיקו לי מאני חנותאי … וס׳</he> get me my shop-tools (the judge’s implements): a stick, a strap, a trumpet (with which to proclaim excommunication) and a sandal (for <cite ref="H01060"><he>חֲלִיצָה</he></cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>סַנְדְּלִין</he>, <he>סַנְדְּלַיָּא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 11:15">Targ. Is. XI, 15</cite>.
